text.en:
Barangays Sumiorang, Ilama, Mansilano, Lico, Ranao-Baning, Aparport, Punud, Lambanogan,
Frankfort, Borantacan, Sumogot, Pagalamatan, Sigua-an, Salam, Piagma, Comara, Natangcopan,
Bandara-Ingud, Miorod, Pagonayan, Bagombayan, all in the municipality of WAO, Lanao del Sur, are hereby
segregated therefrom and shall constitute a separate and independent municipality to be known as the
Municipality of Bumbaran, in the province of Lanao del Sur, and same shall be bounded as follows: On the
East by the mother of Municipality of WAO only separated by a straight line 13.65 km. drawn Northward
from Point-1 to Point-2 on the bank of the Maladugao Boundary line as Point-3; thence by straight line
following the Lumbabayabao-Wao boundary line Southward to the intersection of the Lanao-Cotabato
Boundary as Point-4; thence finally 1.72 Eastward following the Lanao-Cotabato Boundary Line to Point of
The seat of government of the Municipality of Bumbaran shall be Barangay Aparport.

The present elective officials of the Municipality of WAO shall perform their duties as such in
the newly created municipality until the officials of the latter shall have been duly appointed by the President
and shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected in the election for provincial and municipal
officials following the issuance of this Decree, and shall have qualified unless sooner removed at the pleasure
of the President. Other officials and employees necessary in the organization and operation of the municipal
government shall be appointed in the manner provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the corresponding share of the Municipality of Bumbaran in
the obligations, funds, deposits and property of the original municipality of WAO, shall be transferred by the
President to the new Municipality upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

Title to all the property, powers, rights and obligations, or portions thereof formerly belonging to
the original municipality of WAO, shall be vested either in the new municipality of Bumbaran or the mother
of municipality, depending upon the particular territorial jurisdiction in which they are situated.

All laws, decrees, executive orders, ordinances, rules and regulation, or parts thereof,
inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
